items.title: Lenny's Podcast — B2B PLG with Rachbot Founder
items.description: In-depth interview with Rachbot founder on building a product-led B2B sales tool. Covers pricing experiments, sales-assist triggers, and navigating enterprise procurement.

items.title: Product Thinking — Marty Cagan on B2B Product Strategy
items.description: Marty Cagan discusses how B2B product strategy differs from B2C, the importance of empowered product teams in enterprise, and why most B2B product roadmaps fail.

items.title: B2B Product Chat — Enterprise SaaS Metrics
items.description: Weekly podcast dedicated to B2B product management. Covers NDR deep dives, pricing case studies, sales alignment, and interviews with B2B product leaders from GitLab, Datadog, and Snowflake.

items.title: This is Product Management — B2B Edition
items.description: Interviews with product leaders from top B2B companies. Topics include product-led sales, API product management, developer experience, and enterprise customer success.

items.title: The Product-Led Growth Podcast
items.description: Dedicated to product-led growth strategies. B2B-heavy content including episodes on free trial optimization, PQL scoring algorithms, and expansion revenue strategies.

items.title: Hidden Brain — The Psychology of B2B Buying Decisions
items.description: Exploration of the psychological biases and social dynamics behind enterprise purchasing decisions. Relevant for PMs designing B2B products that need to win internal champions.

items.title: Category Pirates — Creating New B2B Markets
items.description: Podcast about creating new market categories. B2B focus with episodes on category design, market creation, and how companies like Salesforce and Slack created new enterprise categories.

items.title: SaaStr Podcast — B2B Pricing Breakdowns
items.description: Weekly deep dives into B2B SaaS pricing strategies. Real numbers from public companies, pricing model analysis, and lessons from pricing failures.

items.title: Acquired — B2B Platform Deep Dives
items.description: Deep-dive episodes on the history and strategy behind major B2B platforms including Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, and Atlassian. Essential listening for B2B PMs.

items.title: The Product Experience — B2B Product Decisions
items.description: Weekly product management podcast with B2B-focused episodes on feature prioritization, stakeholder management, enterprise UX, and product analytics in B2B contexts.
